title: VibeFlow authentication and session implementation reference

better_auth.usage: Email/password and database-backed cookie session mechanics only, wrapped by @vibeflow/identity.

postgresql.usage: Durable Account link and Better Auth-compatible session schema.

security_controls: exact trusted-origin comparison before direct Better Auth API calls
session cookie cache disabled so revocation resolves through PostgreSQL
server-side Account link created in a Better Auth user-create hook
client-supplied link fields ignored by the VibeFlow boundary
unknown, expired, malformed, replayed, revoked, or unlinked sessions fail closed
no raw session token is persisted or returned as ordinary VibeFlow product state
implementation.non_authority_statement: Authentication validates an Account identity only. It does not return or decide Organization, Project, role, grant, policy, or permission authority.

capability_status.VF-IAM-005: IMPLEMENTED — session creation, validation, revocation, secure cookies, and stale/replay rejection are proven by M-009 integration coverage.
capability_status.VF-IAM-006: IMPLEMENTED — email/password authentication is linked by foreign key to a canonical VibeFlow Account and proven by M-009 integration coverage.

local_database_result.reason: The Arena workspace has no PostgreSQL service. The runner emits an explicit NOT EXECUTED message; it does not treat the skipped suite as verification.

ci_requirement.condition: CI fails if DATABASE_URL and VIBEFLOW_DATABASE_URL are both absent; otherwise it runs the M-009 live suite directly.
required_cases: absence of tenant/resource authority in a validated identity result
ci_requirement.candidate_binding: The final protected CI record must match the final PR head. This file does not preclaim a future CI result.

scope_exclusions: M-010 tenant/resource authorization, roles, policy, and OpenFGA
federated login and broad MFA work
mobile UI or HTTP route surface
